decision_scope.scope_boundary: The source decision organizes bed, kitchen, bathroom/toilet and storage together. Furniture moves can test only an explicitly named subdecision; no plumbing, construction or full dwelling reproduction is claimed.

decision_scope.source_decision: Move the lightweight sofa and other movable furniture to adapt the activity space.
decision_scope.executable_part_candidate: Move a mapped substitute sofa instance with the native tool in a declared reconstruction.
decision_scope.not_a_target: Delete seating or bed, invent that all activities occur simultaneously, or label any arbitrary HSSD sofa move as the historical project.
decision_scope.unsupported_part: Murphy-bed articulation, forces/weight and furniture internal mechanisms are not validated. Partial movement evidence does not imply whole-room activity switching success.
decision_scope.implementation_constraint: Preserve native instance identity during our replay. This is not a sourced requirement to retain old furniture.

source_to_scene.geometry_provenance: Declared 5.2 x 3.0 x 2.6 m main-room reconstruction; not survey. Known static-proxy wall overlap and asset substitutions.

verification_needed: Retain all known living/sleep/work/storage functions in the complete scene; mark any unrepresented mechanism explicitly.
Bind source movable sofa to one stable native proxy ID, with initial state and adapted activity request.
Execute the supported move and measure activity-area gain, circulation, window access and displaced uses; preserve side effects and unknowns.
